title: Static members
hook: static belongs to the type, not to an instance. One copy of a static field is shared by every worker thread that can see the type — which is either a feature (cached regex) or a bug (mutable dictionary without locks).

sections.heading: Static classes and members
sections.prose: A static class cannot be instantiated, is sealed, and contains only static members. Math and Console are the textbook BCL examples. Instance members cannot touch instance state from a static method without receiving an instance. Local functions and const are not the same as static, but const is implicitly static in effect: it has no instance.

sections.heading: Shared state in workers
sections.prose: Static readonly after a static constructor is a common way to hold compiled Regex or a frozen mapping of LTI issuers. Static mutable collections in an SQS consumer are a data race unless you use concurrent types or never write after init. Static constructors run before the first use of the type; an exception there becomes TypeInitializationException for the rest of the process lifetime of that type (module 06).

snippets.label: Static cache of issuer prefixes
snippets.explanation: The dictionary is written only during type initialization. After that, readers share it. If you mutated Prefix at runtime you would need a concurrency story (module 15).

sections.heading: What static is not
sections.prose: Static is not a substitute for dependency injection. A static Redis connector hides lifetime and makes tests lie. C# 14 extension members can add static-looking members to other types; that syntax is module 10. Static local functions exist, but they cannot capture locals — they are just private methods with a tighter name.

interviewTakeaways: Static fields are process-wide for that type load.
Static constructors throwing poison the type with TypeInitializationException.
Prefer static for pure functions and frozen lookup tables, not for hidden I/O.
commonPitfalls: Mutable static dictionaries in multi-threaded hosts.
Using static as a service locator for HttpClient or multiplexers.

jsTsCorrelations.note: JS static fields live on the constructor function. There is no static class that forbids new, only convention.
TS static is a constructor-property. C# static is a special member in metadata and can live on a static class with no instances.
